title: Role of flavor degrees of freedom in quantum simulations of disorder-free localization
summary: A recent \texttt{Google Quantum AI} experiment [\href{https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adr9680}{Gyawali \textit{et al.}, Science \textbf{393}, 71 (2026)}] has exploited quantum parallelism to emulate disorder-averaged many-body dynamics, with conserved local degrees of freedom generating an effective disorder potential. We investigate how the local spectrum of these static variables controls localization in a flavor-extended ${\mathbb Z}_2$ lattice gauge theory, which maps onto a mixed-field Ising chain with $n$-level bond disorder.
